caption: The worked example in one column: a 1,000-pixel input is squeezed to a 32-unit code and rebuilt, and the loss flows back to update all 65,032 trainable parameters. Notice the two weight matrices, 32,000 values each, giving the 31.25:1 compression ratio.

spec.title: Autoencoder bottleneck: 1,000 → 32 → 1,000
spec.aria: A vertical flow: the 1,000-pixel input x goes through an encoder holding 32,000 weights and 32 biases to a 32-unit code z, a decoder with 32,000 weights and 1,000 biases rebuilds a 1,000-pixel x-hat, and the MSE loss is backpropagated to update all 65,032 parameters.
